skill.summary: Switch OpenClaw heartbeat model to local Ollama and deploy a guard to prevent unauthorized changes, avoiding paid cloud token usage.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added skill to redirect OpenClaw's heartbeat from cloud to local Ollama model, preventing excessive token use.
- Implements a 60s polling guard to monitor and revert unauthorized changes to heartbeat configuration, with system notifications.
- Provides CLI commands for setup, status monitoring, authorized modification, and uninstallation.
- Ensures all operations are local, secure, and fully reversible with built-in backup and restoration tools.
- Detailed instructions for quick start, Ollama installation, and permission management included.
